data.one_liner: Show a loading overlay to prevent user interaction during async operations.
data.what_it_does: Provides widgets like LoaderOverlay and GlobalLoaderOverlay to block screen interaction while background tasks run. Allows showing progress messages and custom loader widgets via context extensions.
use_when: You need to block screen interactions during async tasks
You want to display global or local loading spinners easily
avoid_when: You are building a package or layer that should not depend on Flutter widgets for state management
You prefer completely custom state-driven overlay implementations
strengths: Simple extension methods on BuildContext for show, hide, and progress
Supports custom loading widgets and global route overlays
Configurable overlay background color and animations
weaknesses: Depends on BuildContext to show or hide the overlay
Tests are not documented as implemented in the package
data.setup_notes: Wrap your MaterialApp or specific widgets with LoaderOverlay or GlobalLoaderOverlay.
